proposal.title: Ynthranae: a lightweight log monitor
proposal.summary: Ynthranae builds a lightweight log monitor for operators of public services.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.text: Domain owners rarely notice certificates issued for their names by mistake. Operators of public services are depending from certificate transparency every day, yet tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text: We are going to build a lightweight log monitor called Ynthranae. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Every component gets tests and a fuzz target before merging of it.

sections.heading: Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
sections.text: Certificate transparency belongs into Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

sections.heading: Team and experience
sections.text: We are maintaining http://forge.test/ynthranae/ynthranae, which 188 public projects depend on. Our team is working on certificate transparency for 9 years.

sections.heading: Deliverables and licence
sections.text: All code will be released under MPL-2.0 licence in http://forge.test/ynthranae/ynthranae. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

sections.heading: Milestones
sections.text: The work runs over 11 months in 4 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 3. Core implementation ends in month 6. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 8. Documentation and release ends in month 11.

sections.heading: Budget justification
sections.text: The plan asks for 64500.00 EUR for 114 days of work over 4 tasks. Day rates range from 450.00 EUR to 750.00 EUR.

proposal.narrative:
Problem
Domain owners rarely notice certificates issued for their names by mistake. Operators of public services are depending from certificate transparency every day, yet tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

Approach
We are going to build a lightweight log monitor called Ynthranae. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Every component gets tests and a fuzz target before merging of it.

Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
Certificate transparency belongs into Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

Team and experience
We are maintaining http://forge.test/ynthranae/ynthranae, which 188 public projects depend on. Our team is working on certificate transparency for 9 years.

Deliverables and licence
All code will be released under MPL-2.0 licence in http://forge.test/ynthranae/ynthranae. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

Milestones
The work runs over 11 months in 4 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 3. Core implementation ends in month 6. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 8. Documentation and release ends in month 11.

Budget justification
The plan asks for 64500.00 EUR for 114 days of work over 4 tasks. Day rates range from 450.00 EUR to 750.00 EUR.
